subject: Re: MAP draft - Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool calling)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-28T15:04:00Z
Subject: Post-demo recap + MAP next steps

Alex - thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

- Needs: SDK-based integration for server-side generation, streaming of partial responses to front-end, tool-calling for order lookup, and structured JSON outputs for downstream processing.
- Risks/Dependencies: Front-end streaming endpoint (your infra), auth/KMS decision for keys, expected throughput (peak 20 req/s).
- Proposed MAP milestone: "Integration build plan" with owners and target close date.

Action items (proposed):
1) Redwood to draft MAP milestone with owners + milestone dates (Ben/Marissa) - target 2027-04-15 for signoff.
2) ACME to confirm internal infra owner for streaming and provide staging endpoints (Alex).
3) Align on auth/KMS approach (security team) - tentative kickoff next week.

Attaching the draft MAP (PDF) and a simple integration sheet. I put Lauren on the thread to help scope SDK work.

Thanks,
Ben
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-29T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP draft - Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool calling)

Alex - thanks Ben. Drafting the MAP milestone below focused on the integration build plan. Please review owners and target dates; call out any blockers.

MAP Milestone: Integration build plan (SDK integration, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs)
- Target close: 2027-04-15
- Success criteria: SDK integrated in staging; streaming to front-end validated; tool-calling wired to order lookup; structured JSON output schema agreed and validated end-to-end.

Owners & Responsibilities:
- SDK integration (server-side): Dev Patel (redwood) - provide SDK + example server snippets, ETA 2027-04-05 for first drop.
- Front-end streaming integration: Acme infra owner (Alex) + Lauren Bishop (redwood) for front-end guidance - confirm staging endpoint by 2027-04-01.
- Tool calling (order lookup): Marissa Cole (redwood) to lead mapping of tool contract and example calls; Acme to provide test API keys, target 2027-04-08.
- Structured outputs (JSON schema): Ben Carter & Dev Patel to propose initial schema by 2027-04-04; ACME to review and approve by 2027-04-10.

Dependencies / Risks:
- KMS/auth decisions (ACME security) - blocking for production keys.
- Throughput profiling required to choose model variant and batching.
- CORS and streaming compatibility with your CDN.

Attachments: acme-map-draft.pdf, map-integration-sheet.xlsx

Next steps: Alex, can you confirm the internal owner for the streaming endpoint and whether ACME can share a staging URL this week? Also flag any internal security review timelines.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dana Lee <dana.lee@acme.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP draft - Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool calling)

Thanks Marissa - this looks great and very actionable. Quick answers:

- Streaming owner: Dana Lee on our infra team (cc'd). We'll try to get a staging endpoint by 2027-04-01.
- KMS: security is on a biweekly review cadence; next slot is 2027-04-06 - that might push production key availability past the MAP target but staging testing should be fine with test keys.
- Tool calling: we can provide a read-only test API key and a mocked order lookup endpoint by 2027-04-05.

Two quick asks:
1) Can you include a small example of the expected structured JSON output (sample payload) in the schema Ben/Dev will propose? That will help our downstream ETL team.
2) Any recommended client-side buffering pattern for smoother streaming rendering?

Appreciate the clarity - will confirm staging owner and URL as soon as Dana has it.

- Alex
Senior PM | Acme Corp
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-30T08:15:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP draft - Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool calling)

Alex/Dana - looping in a short tech note and timeline from our side.

- SDK: We'll provide a Node + Python example showing server-side generation and streaming support. Example drop by 2027-04-05 (early).
- Streaming: Recommended pattern is chunked server-sent events (SSE) or WebSocket streaming with small framing messages (newline-delimited JSON). Client-side: buffer 200-500ms or 3-4 tokens before rendering to reduce jank; we can include a sample buffering helper in the front-end guide.
- Tool calling: we'll include an example driver that maps tool responses into the structured output schema.
- Structured outputs: adding a sample JSON payload to the schema proposal (Ben/Dev) - will include an example with fields: order_id, items[], total_amount, fulfillment_status, source_fragment.

I'll attach the initial integration checklist to the Hub link and update the spreadsheet.

Regards,
Dev Patel
Principal Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Dana Lee <dana.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Marissa/Dev - confirmed: staging endpoint ETA 2027-04-01 (we'll share URL + creds). Dana here - our infra team is good with testing on staging; production KMS timing noted. We'll review the sample JSON when it's available.

One ask from infra: can Redwood provide a small load test profile (20 req/s with 1-2s response) so we can provision staging infra appropriately?

I'll put a calendar invite for a short sync on 2027-04-02 to align owners.

Thanks,
Dana Lee
